cs.t: For me, a knife is just a tool, like scissors. The most used/useful knife I own is this tiny folding pocket knife.  https://www.crkt.com/shop/everyday-carry-knives/delilah-s-p-...  It is undersized for hunting or boating but for actual day to day use it really excels. I use it mostly for opening boxes and occasionally trimming bits off 3D printed parts. I used to carry it in my watch pocket but now it lives in my laptop bag.
cs.th: Ask HN: What is your favorite pocket knife?
